reviews.text: I hope I won't return to this center again. First of all, they vaccinated my cat without a fecal analysis. On August 5th, at the second visit, the cat had abundant and very dark earwax in one ear. The vet, after cleaning it with a cotton swab, simply said I needed to clean his ears, even though it was already obviously abnormal and I had already reported that the cat was itchy. Out of laziness, they left my cat with Malassezia just before going on vacation. The condition worsened, and I had to rush to the only clinic I found open in mid-August. I could have started treatment before the worsening. That's not how it's done.

This clinic deserves at least 10 stars! The team is made up of competent professionals who are always at the forefront. They saved and gave my Sophie more than a year of life here. I looked everywhere before I found them, and only they were able to understand Sophie's condition and provide her with the best care. Beyond their professionalism, I'd like to highlight the team's empathy, kindness, and helpfulness. Clarity, transparency, and honesty regarding the cost of services are also key. The location is logistically perfect, literally a stone's throw from the Montesanto metro station and the Cumana, funicular, and Circumflegrea lines. Thank you always ❤️

I went for the first time for laser therapy on my dog. Everyone was very friendly. Dr. Giovanna was sweet and empathetic. The only downside is getting there by car. However, the metro and Cumana train are just steps away.

I can only be grateful to all the doctors and medical staff at this facility, because in this world, it's not a given to find such care and love, along with professionalism and humanity.
They were admirable in performing a delicate operation on my Maltese.
I urge anyone with a pet to trust them completely, because they're in safe hands.
These guys are not only professional and well-trained, but they also empathize with the animals, putting them at ease without causing them further stress.

Kindness, gentleness towards the animal, professionalism, availability, I wouldn't change for anything, they saved my Minou. Plus, transparency on prices. What more could we ask for! Thanks to them 😻 …
Marianna, thank you for your positive feedback :)

The entire clinic staff cared for and treated my Carmilla with expertise, professionalism, and so much tenderness, as if they'd known her for years, yet we were only in contact for four days.
My little girl didn't make it, but they were fantastic; empathetic, kind, patient, affectionate, and understanding, even with me, who was desperate and in tears. They gave me the time I needed to understand what was happening and say goodbye, and they supported and helped me, without ever rushing me.
But above all, I appreciated the delightful way they interacted with my little cat: tender words and cuddles that certainly helped her in those difficult times. Thank you ❤️

I admit that the judgment of these types of reviews depends on the success of the treatment. Personally, I just want to comment on the professionalism and helpfulness of the staff, which is top-notch!
This center was completely satisfied with my veterinary emergency during these Christmas holidays.
Truly a wonderful and SKILLFUL team. They treated Kyra with kid gloves, and I'm truly grateful for all the support they gave me. Professional, with so much heart and preparation. Thank you guys!
Professionalism, kindness, attention, and lots of cuddles. A safe place for our furry friends. Moka is at home here: loved, spoiled, cared for, and pampered.
A well-kept and well-equipped veterinary practice, and most importantly, the excellent doctors, especially for our friends who they treat with great care, thank you.
Kindness, courtesy, and reassurance. Thank you very much.
